title.value: Open Decks w/ Steen [Full Venue Edition]

value.body: All of our events are 21+ unless otherwise specified. For 21+ events, all guests must show their government-issued photo identification or passport upon entry.
value.title: How old do I have to be to enter SILO?

value.body: SILO is a space for people to dance, to hear music, and to express themselves. While you are here, we want you to feel safe, comfortable, and at home. We do not tolerate violence, harassment, racism, homophobia, transphobia, or bigotry of any kind. We do not allow unwanted contact. This includes leering, staring, and cutting off someone else’s ability to move freely.
value.title: How does SILO promote a Safer Space?

value.body: If you experience behavior that is threatening or that makes you uncomfortable, please approach a staff member. Our staff is trained to handle these situations, and we will actively remove individuals who make others feel unsafe.
value.title: What if I experience inappropriate behavior from someone?

value.body: All spaces in the venue, including the stage, are accessible to wheelchair users. Our main entrance at 90 Scott Avenue is accessible. Our staff is trained to assist you, so just give them a heads up when you arrive and they will make sure you’re able to get in. Reserved seating can be arranged by emailing a11y@silobrooklyn.com. If you have another accessibility concern, please email a11y@silobrooklyn.com, and we would be happy to see how we can accommodate :)
value.title: I’m a wheelchair user and want to experience a night at SILO. How do you make it accessible?

value.body: All of our restrooms are gender neutral. There are two accessible stalls, one in each of the two restrooms at the front. If you need any assistance, let a staff member know and they’ll help you out.
value.title: What about restrooms?

value.body:
On the day of the event (usually 2h before it starts) you’ll be able to activate your ticket in the app and generate your unique QR code.

Just follow these steps.

1\. Open the DICE app. Tap the ticket icon at the bottom of the screen.

2\. Choose the event.

3\. Tap Activate QR code.

Once you activate your ticket, you will no longer be able to send it to a friend.

If you bought tickets for a group and you’re arriving together, you can show everyone’s tickets on your device to the door staff.
value.title: What do I do on the day of the event?

value.body:
Offer your ticket to another fan

We believe tickets belong in the hands of fans, and that they should only ever be sold for a fair price. That’s why we have the Waiting List: if you can’t make it to a sold-out event, you can add your ticket to the queue to be purchased by another fan. If the ticket is sold, you’ll get your money back – no drama, no rip-offs.

There are a few conditions, though. Not every show will have the Waiting List function switched on (that’s up to the event organisers, not DICE), and tickets can only be added to the Waiting List after a show sells out. On top of that – and this is important – you’ll only get your money back if another fan buys your ticket.
value.title: What if I can’t make the event anymore?

value.body:
If a friend is keen to attend an event you can’t make, you can transfer your ticket to them quickly and securely within the app. Just make sure you have their number saved in your phone, and that they have a DICE account registered with that number.

After you transfer the ticket, it will be stored within the DICE app on your friend’s phone – there’s no fiddling with name changes, emailing PDFs, or sending across screenshots. It’s just another way we make sure tickets don’t fall into the wrong hands.
value.title: Transfer your ticket to a friend

value.body: Our ticketed music events have loud music and use strobe lights and haze. If you have allergies or sensitivities to these things, please be aware that we use them in our performances.
value.title: Do you guys use haze/fog?

value.body: There is a water station at the front bar with free water. The bar sells chicken tenders, vegan nuggets, hippeas, and pork rinds.
value.title: I’m kind of hungry and thirsty. What should I do?

value.body: Earplugs are $2 at the front bar.
value.title: Do you sell earplugs?

value.body: All tickets can be found on our Dice.fm page, and all ticket sales are final. If an event is postponed or rescheduled, ticket holders will be able to keep their ticket for the rescheduled date or claim a refund. In the event of a full cancellation, refunds will be processed automatically.
value.title: How do I get tickets at SILO?

value.body: Yes! We sell tickets at the door on a first-come first-serve basis.
value.title: Will there be tickets at the door?

value.body: The front room lounge of SILO is open Wednesday, 8pm-2am for Open Decks and Thursday 9pm-3am, usually for a DJ event with a local collective. Open Decks and most Thursday events are free as long as you RSVP ahead of time on Dice. Once a month or so we have a free-with-RSVP weekend event.
value.title: Do you only have ticketed events?

value.body: We usually allow re-entry, but for sold out shows exits may be final if we are at capacity.
value.title: Are exits final? What if I gotta step out for a second?

value.body: There is a designated smoking area just outside the side door to the right of the stage. There will be a member of our security team at the door who will check your stamp upon re-entering the venue.
value.title: What if I want to have a smoke?

value.body: Yes! Each item is $5, cash or card.
value.title: Its gonna be a hot night, but I got this big coat on me...you guys got a coat check?

raw.description:
Hosted by DJ and musician Steen, Open Decks is a creative and fun space where DJs can hang and share their house and techno music live.

If you want to play, talk to Steen to sign up. Sign-up is in person at the event only, slots are 12 minutes.

The first 3 DJ's play first-come-first-spin. Then we'll select names randomly from the sign-up list throughout the night. You'll get a half hour notice before your set time. This is to ensure that DJ's who can't make the initial sign up right at 7pm still get a chance to play.

Free with advance RSVP. Question? Hit up your host on IG @steenschmidt

This edition will the in the FULL VENUE, it will last an extra hour, and we'll have 3 different local collectives return to co-host, including Timeless Nexus, Bojaq, and Lordoflimbo.

Slots will go fast, make sure to show up early for sign-up.

On the day of the event (usually 2h before it starts) you’ll be able to activate your ticket in the app and generate your unique QR code.

Just follow these steps.

1\. Open the DICE app. Tap the ticket icon at the bottom of the screen.

2\. Choose the event.

3\. Tap Activate QR code.

Once you activate your ticket, you will no longer be able to send it to a friend.

If you bought tickets for a group and you’re arriving together, you can show everyone’s tickets on your device to the door staff.
value.title: What do I do on the day of the event?

value.body:
Offer your ticket to another fan

We believe tickets belong in the hands of fans, and that they should only ever be sold for a fair price. That’s why we have the Waiting List: if you can’t make it to a sold-out event, you can add your ticket to the queue to be purchased by another fan. If the ticket is sold, you’ll get your money back – no drama, no rip-offs.

There are a few conditions, though. Not every show will have the Waiting List function switched on (that’s up to the event organisers, not DICE), and tickets can only be added to the Waiting List after a show sells out. On top of that – and this is important – you’ll only get your money back if another fan buys your ticket.
value.title: What if I can’t make the event anymore?

value.body:
If a friend is keen to attend an event you can’t make, you can transfer your ticket to them quickly and securely within the app. Just make sure you have their number saved in your phone, and that they have a DICE account registered with that number.

After you transfer the ticket, it will be stored within the DICE app on your friend’s phone – there’s no fiddling with name changes, emailing PDFs, or sending across screenshots. It’s just another way we make sure tickets don’t fall into the wrong hands.

MIJA kicks off her nine-city USA tour with AGAPE in Brooklyn this winter. The Berlin-based artist is known for her playfully diverse sound - merging Hard Disco, Soft Groove, and a ton of dance music in between.

This special edition of MIJA Invites welcomes Norwegian producer and international artist MRD, along with AGAPE resident FLASH GEA, and local DJ/Producer SLOWDANCEXO.

After dozens of SOLD-OUT events this year alone, expect Friday, November 27th to be yet another electric evening filled with top-notch talent shaping the entire night.

21+ with valid photo ID presented.

COMMUNITY GUIDELINES

Be present. Respect the dancefloor and keep phone use to a minimum.

Respect the space and the people around you. Everyone is welcome. Harassment, discrimination, or aggressive behavior will not be tolerated.

Consent is mandatory. Respect personal boundaries at all times.

Look out for each other. If something feels off, please speak to a member of the AGAPE team or venue staff.

Come for the music, stay for the community.

ALL SALES ARE FINAL. NO REFUNDS.
